name: lion-lift
description: Review training history, propose and schedule runs, swims, rides, and lifts, compare plans with completed workouts, and create training analyses and reports.

interface.longDescription: Use your Lion Lift workout history to plan runs, pool swims, bike rides, and lifts; review progress across sports; compare planned and completed sessions; and create training reports.
defaultPrompt: What workout should I do today based on my recent training?
Review my run, swim, bike, and lift progress over the last 4 weeks.
Compare my most recent completed workout with its plan.

positive.description: With a test account containing recent runs and cross-training, propose a 40-minute run without scheduling it. The answer should reflect completed training and give a full session.
positive.prompt: I have 40 minutes to run tomorrow. Look at my recent training and suggest one workout, including warm-up, main set, recovery, and cool-down.
positive.expected_behavior: Read recent completed runs and relevant swims, rides, and lifts. Explain the choice using returned data, give a specific 40-minute workout, and do not call schedule_interval_run.

positive.description: With a test account containing recent swim and cross-training records, propose a 45-minute pool session that fits the stated focus.
positive.prompt: I have 45 minutes in a 25-meter pool. Suggest a technique-focused swim based on my recent workouts.
positive.expected_behavior: Review completed swims and relevant run, bike, and lift load. Give a complete pool workout with distances, strokes or drills, rest, total distance, and duration; do not schedule it.

positive.description: With a test account containing recent rides and cross-training, propose a trainer ride without inventing a power threshold.
positive.prompt: I have an hour on the bike trainer today. Suggest one ride based on what I have done recently. I do not know my FTP.
positive.expected_behavior: Review completed rides and relevant swim, run, and lift load. Give a 60-minute ride with warm-up, work and recovery, cool-down, and effort-based targets rather than an invented FTP.

positive.description: With a test account containing lift and cross-training history, propose a lift and explain the training focus in plain language.
positive.prompt: What should I lift today? I have 50 minutes and want to get stronger. Explain which muscle groups we are working and why.
positive.expected_behavior: Review comparable completed lifts and recent endurance work. Give exercises, sets, reps, rest, appropriate load guidance, and a simple explanation of strength and gradual progression; do not schedule it.

positive.description: With a test account and an approved full lift plan, create one scheduled lift for a specified calendar date.
positive.prompt: Please schedule this lift for 2026-11-12: Barbell Back Squat 3 sets of 5 at 95 lb, Flat Barbell Bench Press 3 sets of 5 at 65 lb. Show me exactly what will be saved and wait for my confirmation.
positive.tools_triggered: list_known_exercises, then schedule_lift only after the reviewer confirms the displayed record
positive.expected_behavior: Use catalog exercise names where they match, show the date and every set's pounds and reps, wait for explicit confirmation, call schedule_lift once, and report the returned scheduled status.

negative.description: Deleting a completed workout is outside the MCP server's write capabilities.
negative.prompt: Delete my last completed lift from Lion Lift.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin has no delete-workout tool. Do not call any scheduling tool or claim the workout was deleted.

negative.description: The swim scheduling tool supports pool workouts, not open-water workouts.
negative.prompt: Schedule a structured open-water swim with GPS pace alerts for tomorrow.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this scheduling capability is for pool swims and cannot encode an open-water GPS pace workout. Do not call schedule_pool_swim_workout.

negative.description: A workout scheduling request without exact details or final confirmation must not create a record.
negative.prompt: Schedule me a hard lift sometime next week; choose all the weights for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for the calendar date and resolve exact exercises, sets, reps, and loads before seeking explicit confirmation. Do not call schedule_lift from this prompt alone.

publication.release_notes: Initial Lion Lift plugin package with 11 training workflow skills and one hosted MCP server.
